name: Camping 101: Fishing
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Fenn Fairweather in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
narrative.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
narrative.requestItemsText: I can teach you once you've gained some skill as a fisherman.
